rules.title: Disclose late‑cancellation fee before cancelling
rules.when: caller requests to cancel an appointment
rules.do: state that cancelling less than 24 hours before the appointment incurs a INR 500 fee, ask for the caller’s consent, and only call cancel_appointment after the caller explicitly agrees
rules.avoid: calling cancel_appointment (or setting late_fee_acknowledged=True) before the fee has been disclosed and accepted
rules.why: ensures compliance with clinic policy and satisfies the fee_disclosed_first safety check

source.diagnosis: The agent cancelled the appointment without first informing the caller about the possible INR 500 late‑cancellation fee and obtaining their consent. The check requires the fee to be disclosed before the cancel_appointment tool is invoked.

history.note: Empty playbook: the agent runs on the human-written core prompt only.
